title: Hooks System
description: Root hooks module. Encapsulates rules, features, and event schemas. Declarations for child modules: rules, engine, features.

rules.description: Rule index (O(1) lookup by rule name)

features.description: Feature registry — config for lint, doc-size-checker, agent

engine.description: Hooks engine — orchestrates rule matching and feature execution

state.description: Dedup state manager — tracks rule firing per session

events.description: Hook event schema registry — 26 event types

x-bus-surface.description: Engine entry point. hook adapter sends event here.
Reload engine match data. hook.mjs handles → rules.reload() fn call.

x-docs.intent: Root hooks module encapsulation. Single config.json leaf node. Declares child modules (rules/features/engine). Internal module communication via fn call, not bus. Bus surface: hooks:process_event + engine:reload.
